analysis.rationale: Strong financial performance with significant YoY growth in EBITDA and PAT, indicating improved profitability and operational efficiency.
analysis.summary: Kokuyo Camlin reported FY2025-26 revenue of ₹80,597 lakhs (up 5.70% YoY), EBITDA of ₹4,945 lakhs (up 56.24% YoY), and PAT of ₹2,479 lakhs (up 325% YoY).
